skills.name: arc:audit
skills.description: Read-only evaluation (只读) that produces ranked, evidence-backed findings and never edits code: review a diff, PR or branch (代码评审), project health and code-rot audit (体检, 技术债), AppSec audit and threat model, secret, dependency and SAST scans (安全扫描, Semgrep, 漏洞), and authorized DAST. Not for fixes (use arc:code), tests (use arc:verify), or posting comments on CNB pull requests (use cnb-code-review).

intent_router.Condition: Diff, PR, branch, commit range or patch file
Health, code rot, tech debt, maintainability, architecture or release readiness; "审计/audit" with no security word
Security, vulnerability, AppSec, threat model, data exposure, AuthZ
Scanner name, secrets/dependency/SAST scan, DAST, re-scan
AppSec audit plus tool scans

skills.name: arc:code
skills.description: Every task that changes source code: write code to implement (写代码, 实现, 开发功能, 落地改动) a feature or endpoint; fix (修复) a bug, error (报错), incident or failing test by evidence-first root-cause repair (根因); refactor (重构) or migrate; change an API or schema; build frontend pages (前端, shadcn, 小程序); apply Go backend layering (DIP, usecase, 分层); write comments (注释); or add timing probes to a Gin SSR path (计时, 探针, 埋点). Ends with the gate.sh completion check. Not for read-only review (use arc:audit), test design or release evidence (use arc:verify), or PRDs and task docs (use arc:plan).

intent_router.Condition: New feature, endpoint, job or behavior from a known requirement
Bug, error, crash, failing test, regression, incident, failure-justified optimization
Refactor, rename, move, migrate; shape change of an API, DTO, schema, event or config key
Web, mobile, desktop or mini-program page, component, state or theme
Add or correct code comments only
Timing probes on a slow request path
Any mode editing Go backend code
Any mode adding or changing an API
Any mode writing SQL, transactions, migrations or state transitions

skills.name: arc:explore
skills.description: Read-only code intelligence for a local repository: find where code lives (代码在哪, 搜代码), locate definitions, list callers (谁调用), trace a call chain (调用链) or data flow, list everything a planned change would touch (影响面 / impact analysis), and draw a module or architecture map (架构地图). Also maintains the arc-idx / zoekt index (索引维护: doctor, index, daemon). Not for edits (use arc:code), read-only risk review (use arc:audit), or tests (use arc:verify).

intent_router.Condition: Question contains 改, 换, 删, 重命名, rename, remove, replace, or asks what a change touches (影响面)
Who calls X, call chain, data flow (谁调用, 调用链)
Where a file, definition or string lives (代码在哪, 搜代码, 找符号)
Module or system structure, entry points, layers (架构地图, 模块梳理)
doctor, index, daemon, stale or suspicious results, index config

skills.name: arc:plan
skills.description: Turns intent into executable written specs without touching source code: write a PRD or blueprint (写PRD, 立项, 需求文档), clarify a vague request (需求澄清, clarify) into a brief with acceptance criteria (验收标准), break work into tasks (拆任务), create or maintain docs/00-11 task documents (任务文档) and progress tracking (进度跟踪), or turn audit findings into task batches. Not for implementation (use arc:code) or Lark workspace sync (use lark-workflow-project-docs).

intent_router.Condition: Idea or product needs a PRD, or an existing PRD must be refreshed
Request lacks goal, scope, constraints or acceptance; T2 work needs a brief
Break work into tasks; create, resume or update task documents, statuses or the tracker

skills.name: arc:verify
skills.description: Produces evidence about behavior: write tests (写测试) and test plans (测试方案, 用例设计, 测试范围), regression and E2E suites, coverage (覆盖率) and fuzz, reliability checks (可靠性, 业务不变量) for transactions and concurrency (事务并发), idempotency (幂等), faults and recovery; PostgreSQL release qualification (G0-G31); flaky-test triage; load tests (压测); and release go/no-go gates (发布验收, 发布证据). Verdicts are PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN/FLAKY backed by independent oracles. Not for fixing the defects it finds (use arc:code) or static review (use arc:audit).

intent_router.Condition: Test plan, case list or scope only; nothing to execute
Write or run unit, integration, contract, E2E, UI, load or benchmark tests
Invariant, transaction, concurrency, idempotency, retry, async, fault or recovery claim
PostgreSQL schema/DDL, migration, query plan or index, isolation or locking, replication/CDC, backup/PITR/failover, major upgrade or role/RLS change heading to release
Same code passes and fails; intermittent CI failure
Release candidate go/no-go, canary, rollback readiness, incident follow-up controls
One end-to-end claim → case → evidence example
